name: Transport Office
content: From 1 June, motorised delivery e-scooters are banned from sidewalks and shared paths. 212 pedestrians were injured last year. Riders will use road lanes; 40 km of protected lanes will follow. Fines start at $150.

name: Greywalkers
content: We asked for this after too many of our members were hurt. Thank you. Now enforce it quickly.
